name: Bedroom Age
flavour: A laptop, a deadline, and a truly heroic amount of caffeine.

name: Startup Age
flavour: There is a whiteboard now. Nobody has used it correctly yet.

name: Data Centre Age
flavour: The GPUs have their own room. The room has its own electricity bill.

name: Hyperscale Age
flavour: Somewhere, a hardware vendor is naming a SKU after your floorplan.

name: Sovereign Compute Age
flavour: A government asked, politely, whether you would mind being regulated.

name: Planetary Compute Age
flavour: Every data centre on Earth is, in some sense, now your problem.

name: Post-Human Compute Age
flavour: Nobody is entirely sure who is running the company anymore. The invoices still go out on time.
